name: 成本（控制/优化/分析）体系

map.成本（控制/优化/分析）体系是做什么的？: What does Cost Optimization & Analysis System do?
map.如何使用成本（控制/优化/分析）体系？: How do I use Cost Optimization & Analysis System?
map.成本（控制/优化/分析）体系适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Cost Optimization & Analysis System best for?
map.📖 查看「成本（控制/优化/分析）体系使用指南」: 📖 View the "Cost Optimization & Analysis System Guide"
map.在「成本项,金额」后可选加第三列「固定/变动」，工具据此拆出固定成本、变动成本与: Add an optional third column "fixed/variable" after "item,amount"; the tool then splits fixed and variable costs, computes per-unit figures, ranks cost-reduction priorities and derives break-even output. Rows without a type are counted as unclassified and only used for totals and shares. Results are for reference only; formal budgets follow your finance policy and current regulations.
map.每行输入「成本项,金额[,固定/变动]」，如：原料,42,变动: Enter one item per line as "item,amount[,fixed/variable]", e.g. raw material,42,variable
map.产量（可选，金额与产量需同一口径）: Output volume (optional; use the same unit basis as amounts)
map.单价（可选，示例按万元/件）: Unit price (optional; the example assumes 10k CNY per unit)
map.把各项成本金额贴入，看合计、均值与占比最大的成本项。: Paste each cost amount to see the total, the mean and the largest item by share.
map.在第三列标注「固定/变动」，拆出固定成本与变动成本，算出单位成本与盈亏平衡产量。: Tag each row fixed or variable in the third column to split fixed and variable costs and compute per-unit cost and break-even volume.
map.对比本期与上期成本，用极差判断是普遍上升还是个别项异常拉高。: Compare this period's cost with the previous period and use the range to judge whether the rise is broad or driven by one abnormal item.
map.原料 42（变动）、人工 31（固定）、物流 15（变动）、能耗 9（固定）：合: Raw material 42 (variable), labor 31 (fixed), logistics 15 (variable), energy 9 (fixed): total 97, fixed 40 (41.24%), variable 57 (58.76%). With output 1,000 and a unit price of 0.12, unit cost is 0.0970, unit variable cost 0.0570 and contribution 0.0630, so break-even output = 40 ÷ 0.0630 (about 634.9); current output of 1,000 is above break-even. Variable-cost priority is raw material 42, then logistics 15; fixed costs are addressed by renegotiating contracts or spreading capacity.
map.多项成本怎么分组？: How should multiple cost items be grouped?
map.可按部门或产品线分次贴入分别统计，再横向比较占比；同一次统计内保持科目口径一致。: Paste them in batches by department or product line and analyse each separately, then compare shares; keep the category basis consistent within one run.
map.能自动归类成本项吗？: Can it categorize cost items automatically?
map.不会自动识别科目。可在每行第三列手动标注「固定」或「变动」（也接受 F/V），工: It does not infer categories. Tag each row fixed or variable in the third column (F/V also accepted) and the tool splits accordingly; untagged rows are counted as unclassified and only used for totals and shares.
map.需要同时填写产量与单价，且单价必须高于单位变动成本；否则边际贡献 ≤ 0，任何产: Enter both output volume and unit price, and the price must exceed unit variable cost; otherwise contribution is ≤ 0 and no output can cover fixed costs, which the page warns about.
map.在「成本项,金额」后标注固定/变动，拆出固定与变动成本、单位成本与盈亏平衡产量，: Tag each row fixed or variable to split fixed and variable costs, compute per-unit cost and break-even output, and rank cost-reduction priorities by variable-cost amount.
